g.title: HR_ACCOUNTABILITYTYPE
g.text: Accountability Type - This entity represents a type of relationship between two types of items.
Represents the Type of Accountability, like for example Positions to Unit, Person to Person, Locations in Company etc.
The Identifier of the Party Type record.
The Identifier of the Party Type record.
The Identifier of the Structure Type record.
Flag indicating that the structure his hierarchical.
This flag indicates if a node in the structure can have parent null, that is also to say it can be a root node.
Flag indicating that the structure is managed on historical basis.
This flag indicates if each node in the structure can have maximum one related node at any single point in time.
If this flag is set, browsing the second level parties can be done with an explicit command instead of the Treeview expand.
The resource text associated to the Related Party.
The resource text associated to the Related Party.
The Identifier of the Accountability Entity record.
The Identifier of the Default Search Page record.
A number indicating the importance of the entity it relates to.
Indicates if party type is leaf
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: HR_COMPANYACCOUNTABILITY
g.text: Company to Company Accountabilities - This Entity represents the hierarchical relationship between Companies in the same Group. Used for example to represent a relationship between an Holding and depending companies.
The Identifier of the Structure Type record.
It’s Identifier of a Type of Accountability, where the semantic of the relationship is defined.
